def choose_move(observation):
    # Defensive extraction of grid dimensions
    grid_size = observation.get('grid_size', (1, 1))
    max_x, max_y = grid_size

    # Defensive extraction of own position
    own_pos = observation.get('own_position', (0, 0))
    x, y = own_pos

    # Initialize move to stay in place
    dx, dy = 0, 0

    # Determine game type
    game_type = observation.get('game_type', '')

    if game_type == 'resource_collection':
        resources = observation.get('resources', [])
        if resources:
            # Find nearest resource
            nearest_res = min(resources, key=lambda r: abs(r[0] - x) + abs(r[1] - y))
            dx_res = (nearest_res[0] - x)
            dy_res = (nearest_res[1] - y)
            # Clamp move to -1, 0, 1
            dx, dy = (0 if dx_res == 0 else (1 if dx_res > 0 else -1)), \
                     (0 if dy_res == 0 else (1 if dy_res > 0 else -1))
        else:
            # No resources detected, stay in place
            dx, dy = 0, 0

    elif game_type == 'pursuit_evasion':
        opponents = observation.get('opponent_positions', [])
        if opponents:
            # Find nearest opponent
            nearest_op = min(opponents, key=lambda p: abs(p[0] - x) + abs(p[1] - y))
            dx_op = (nearest_op[0] - x)
            dy_op = (nearest_op[1] - y)
            dx, dy = (0 if dx_op == 0 else (1 if dx_op > 0 else -1)), \
                     (0 if dy_op == 0 else (1 if dy_op > 0 else -1))
        else:
            # No opponents detected, stay in place
            dx, dy = 0, 0

    elif game_type == 'territory_control':
        # Aim to move towards the center of the grid
        center_x, center_y = (max_x - 1) / 2, (max_y - 1) / 2
        dx_center = center_x - x
        dy_center = center_y - y
        dx, dy = (0 if dx_center == 0 else (1 if dx_center > 0 else -1)), \
                 (0 if dy_center == 0 else (1 if dy_center > 0 else -1))
    else:
        # Default behavior: stay in place
        dx, dy = 0, 0

    return [dx, dy]
